import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path('/home/joshua/lonely-runner-formalization')
manifest = json.loads(Path('/tmp/astra-pass72-inputs.json').read_text())
assert len(manifest['hashes']) == 3
assert len(manifest['dependency_hashes']) == 8
bindings = manifest['hashes'] | manifest['dependency_hashes']
for name, digest in bindings.items():
    data = (root / name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == digest, name
    assert data.endswith(b'\n'), name
    assert all(line.rstrip() == line for line in data.splitlines()), name
author = 'research/astra-joint-seed-maximum-audit.md'
review = 'research/astra-joint-seed-maximum-review.md'
review_text = (root / review).read_text()
assert bindings[author] in review_text
for digest in manifest['dependency_hashes'].values():
    assert digest in (root / author).read_text()
    assert digest in review_text
commands = []
for argv in ([sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/validate_workflow.py'],
             ['git', 'diff', '--check'],
             [sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/manage_storage.py']):
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    commands.append({'argv': argv, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
                     'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
    assert result.returncode == 0, commands[-1]
print(json.dumps({'frozen_files': 3, 'dependency_bindings': 8,
                  'review_bindings': 9, 'commands': commands}, indent=2))
